## About
RPM Performance started as a garage shop in Westfield, Indiana, where we modified and built performance, racing and restoration project cars. Today we work out of our facility on South East Street, just south of downtown Indianapolis.
We do complete frame-off restorations, engine mods, resto mods and high performance and racing modifications. Our shop has an engine dyno and a chassis dyno, a paint booth and body shop, a performance parts department and a nitrous fill station.
Whether it's a Mustang or a Camaro, a vintage car or a souped-up muscle car, our mechanics can take care of it from start to finish. Call and talk to a car enthusiast.

## Services
- Restorations: Partial restorations up to complete frame-off work on classic and muscle cars.
- Engine building: Engine builds, repairs, tune ups and performance upgrades.
- Body work and paint: Our own paint booth and body shop for dent and rust repair, paint work and bodywork modifications.
- Interior restoration: Upholstery, carpet, headliners, door panels, consoles and gauges.
- Custom exhaust and fabrication: Header and exhaust installs, single to dual exhaust conversions and custom fabrication.
- Electrical troubleshooting: Wiring harness repair and replacement, ignition systems, lighting and power accessories.
- Suspension and chassis work: Suspension and chassis repair, replacement and upgrades.
- Hard to find parts: Our parts department can help track down the parts your project needs.
- Nitrous fill station

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday and closed on weekends.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 3202 South East Street, just south of downtown Indianapolis.

Q: Do you only work on classic cars?
A: No. We work on both classic and modern muscle cars and hot rods.

## What customers say
- "The engine in my 1985 Silverado shortbed had a Crack in the block and locked up. So I did my research and was able to get an amazing deal on a 383 Stroker from Blueprint Engines. I called a shop and they said it would be awhile before they would be able to install it. I received the engine in June. By the time October came around I was tired of waiting. I contacted a person in my local car community and he recommended RPM Performance.
RPM Performance was able to get me in the next week. It took a few days and the engine was installed by a gentleman named Jim. Jim did an amazing job! The engine it tuned wonderfully. The power is amazing. The transmission has a 2500rpm stall converter and a shift kit. I drove the truck home and it was amazing. The next morning there was transmission fluid all over my garage floor. A couple days later she was back in the shop. I had the transmission rebuilt and it still leaked. So after the truck being in an out of shop Bob ( the owner ) put a new transmission in my truck. I changed the rear gear from a 3.08 to a 3.73. Since I had the rear end apart, I had an Eaton posi installed.
Bob and RPM Performance has stood by me when I was having problems with my TH350 transmission. They are good people who stand by their work." (Wallace Flowers, 5/5)
